scope: Actual Tusken Scavengers actions with two Tusken Raiders: destiny 0/1/2/3 and failed draw, three equipment types interleaved with non-equipment, forward/reverse loss ordering, no equipment, Light turn and weapons segment. Compare paid Force, source Lost, both-seat reveal and exact ordered Used/Lost piles. No production GEMP source changes.

PutCardsFromCardPileInCardPileEffect.java and PutOneCardFromCardPileInCardPileEffect.java: sequential eligible losses and off-table placement result

differences: Printed Tusken Scavengers says may scavenge. Native offers decline after successful destiny. Pinned GEMP goes directly to reveal; matching outcomes explicitly accept native search.

AR p11 assigns unspecified multi-card pile placement order to the turn player. Native uses that seat. Pinned GEMP uses the Interrupt player (Dark) even on Light turn; matching final-pile tests deliberately choose the same order and do not claim legal-choice parity.

limits: Current on-table Raider count recognizes starter Tusken Raider 1_196 only.
